{
  "title": "Find most frequent artist in personalized recommendations",
  "applicability": "Music-service tasks asking which artist appears most in personalized recommendations returned as paginated songs with nested artists.",
  "procedure": [
    "Check recommendation API docs for authentication, pagination limits, and nested artist response shape.",
    "Login and keep the access token required for personalized recommendations.",
    "Fetch pages using max allowed page size; stop on empty or short page.",
    "Flatten artists arrays from all songs.",
    "Count occurrences by stable artist ID while storing display names.",
    "Return the display name of the highest-count artist.",
    "Confirm aggregation covered all pages before answering."
  ],
  "pitfalls": [
    "Personalized data may require a valid access token.",
    "Recommendations may be songs, not artist rankings; aggregate nested artists.",
    "Page size may be capped; invalid limits can fail.",
    "One page may omit the top artist.",
    "Counting songs can misrank artists with multiple tracks.",
    "Tie handling was not demonstrated."
  ],
  "evidence_steps": [
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5,
    6,
    7
  ]
}

Task: find most recommended artist from personalized recommendations. Steps: inspect API descriptions, doc show_recommendations, login to get token, paginate recommendations with page_limit max 20 until empty or short page, aggregate artist occurrences across songs by artist id, choose most common, answer name. Pitfalls: recommendations are songs not artists; need aggregate artists; page_limit constrained <=20; need access token for personalized; don't assume first page enough; handle empty pages; tie? Applicability: tasks asking for aggregate property of personalized recommendations on a music service with paginated recommendations endpoint. Procedure: inspect docs, authenticate, request pages, aggregate nested artist objects by stable id, map id to name, select max count, verify. Pitfalls: personalized endpoint requires token; page limit max 20; stop when empty or partial page; count all artist appearances not songs; artist may appear on multiple songs; missing fields use safe get; don't infer hidden recommendation ranking beyond observed counts.
